about: measure contests of 2024 in South Dakota, in the layout of plan/PLAN.md section 3 with the fields data/README.md adds (D3). Built by pipeline/local_medsl.py from pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py's cache.

medsl.name: MIT Election Data and Science Lab, Precinct-Level Returns 2024 by Individual State, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/NYTPDU, version 1.0
medsl.note: precinct returns compiled by MEDSL from each state's official sources (named per state in its README); added up to the contest by pipeline/intake/medsl_precinct.py, files 2024-sd-precinct-general.csv

model.name: the model's own forecast, method D3-v1.1
model.note: each year forecast from a fit on earlier years only; no polls are used

nara.name: National Archives, Electoral College Results (the sitting president's party)
nara.licence: US federal public record; no licence printed

klarner.name: Carl Klarner, State Legislative Election Returns, 1967-2022, Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/FJOGJB, v1.0, released 2024-06-12T21:56:14Z (the races route (a) is fitted on)

question.title: Constitutional Amendment F: An Amendment To The South Dakota Constitution Authorizing The State To Impose A Work Requirement On Individuals Eligible For Expanded Medicaid Benefits

threshold.rule: Majority of votes cast on the amendment
threshold.quote: Any constitutional amendment or revision must be submitted to the voters and shall become a part of the Constitution only when approved by a majority of the votes cast thereon.
threshold.matched: by the type the source's title states (amendment)

p.under: the model's own (D3-v1.1), like past measures
p.note: this route's back-test shows more near-even finishes than it forecast (54 against 38.1 within 5 points, 2018 to 2024), so p may be low
